name: Web Sync (RSync)
tagline: Websync is intended to be an rsync task manager, where rsync tasks can be added, scheduled and maintained in a sane manner.
description: Websync is intended to be an rsync task manager, where rsync tasks can be added, scheduled and maintained in a sane manner.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: furier/websync:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    working_dir: /src
    command:
      - node
      - server.js
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data
        target: /data
